verses.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
verses.pt: E Pedro e João estavam subindo juntos para o Templo à hora da oração (a nona hora );
verses.en_web: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
verses.en_bbe: Now Peter and John were going up to the Temple at the ninth hour, the hour of prayer;

verses.en: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.pt: E um certo homem estava sendo trazido, que era aleijado desde o ventre de sua mãe, ao qual todo dia colocavam à porta do Templo, chamada Porta Formosa, para pedir esmola aos que entravam no Templo.
verses.en_web: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
verses.en_bbe: And a certain man who from birth had had no power in his legs, was taken there every day, and put down at the door of the Temple which is named Beautiful, requesting money from those who went into the Temple;

verses.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
verses.pt: O qual, ao ver Pedro e João perto de entrarem no Templo, ele lhes pediu uma esmola.
verses.en_web: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
verses.en_bbe: He then, seeing Peter and John going into the Temple, made a request to them.

verses.en: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
verses.pt: E Pedro, olhando fixamente para ele, junto com João, disse: Olha para nós.
verses.en_web: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
verses.en_bbe: And Peter, looking at him, with John, said, Keep your eyes on us.

verses.en: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.pt: E o aleijado ficou prestando atenção neles, esperando receber deles alguma coisa.
verses.en_web: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave attention to them, hoping to get something from them.

verses.en: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.pt: E Pedro disse: Prata e ouro eu não tenho; mas o que eu tenho, isso eu te dou: no nome de Jesus Cristo, o nazareno, levanta-te, e anda!
verses.en_web: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
verses.en_bbe: But Peter said, I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up on your feet.

verses.en: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.pt: E, tomando-o pela mão direita, levantou -o; e logo os seus pés e tornozelos ficaram firmes.
verses.en_web: He took him by the right hand, and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
verses.en_bbe: And he took him by his right hand, lifting him up; and straight away his feet and the bones of his legs became strong,

verses.en: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.pt: E ele, saltando, pôs-se de pé, e andou, e entrou com eles no Templo, andando, e saltando, e louvando a Deus.
verses.en_web: Leaping up, he stood, and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
verses.en_bbe: And, jumping up, he got on to his feet and went into the Temple with them, walking and jumping and giving praise to God.

verses.en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
verses.pt: E todo o povo o viu andar, e louvar a Deus.
verses.en_web: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

verses.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
verses.pt: E eles o reconheceram, que este era o que se sentava para pedir esmola perto da porta formosa do Templo; e ficaram cheios de surpresa e espanto, por causa do que tinha lhe acontecido.
verses.en_web: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
verses.en_bbe: And they saw that it was the man who made requests for money at the door of the Temple, and they were full of wonder and surprise at what had taken place.

verses.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
verses.pt: E o aleijado que tinha sido curado, tendo se apegado a Pedro e a João, todo o povo correu maravilhado a eles ao pórtico, que se chama de Salomão.
verses.en_web: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
verses.en_bbe: And while he kept his hands on Peter and John, all the people came running together to the covered way which is named Solomon's, full of wonder.

verses.en: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
verses.pt: Quando Pedro viu isso, respondeu ao povo: “Homens israelitas, por que vos maravilhais disto? Ou por que vós olhais tão atentamente para nós, como se por nosso próprio poder ou devoção divina o tivéssemos feito andar?
verses.en_web: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
verses.en_bbe: And when Peter saw it he said to the people, You men of Israel, why are you so greatly surprised at this man? or why are you looking at us as if by our power or virtue we had given him the use of his legs?

verses.en: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
verses.pt: O Deus de Abraão, e de Isaque, e de Jacó, o Deus de nossos pais, glorificou a seu filho Jesus, ao qual vós entregastes, e diante do rosto de Pilatos o negastes, mesmo ele julgando que fosse solto.
verses.en_web: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up, and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
verses.en_bbe: The God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has given glory to his servant Jesus; whom you gave up, turning your backs on him, when Pilate had made the decision to let him go free.

verses.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
verses.pt: Mas vós negastes ao santo e justo, e pedistes que um homem assassino fosse vos dado.
verses.en_web: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
verses.en_bbe: But you would have nothing to do with the Holy and Upright One, and made request for a man of blood to be given to you,

verses.en: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
verses.pt: E vós matastes ao Príncipe da vida, ao qual Deus ressuscitou dos mortos, do que nós somos testemunhas.
verses.en_web: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
verses.en_bbe: And put to death the Lord of life; whom God gave back from the dead; of which fact we are witnesses.

verses.en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.pt: E pela fé em seu nome, o nome dele deu firmeza a este, que vedes e conheceis; e a fé que é por meio dele deu a este perfeita saúde na presença de todos vós.
verses.en_web: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.en_bbe: And his name, through faith in his name, has made this man strong, whom you see and have knowledge of: yes, the faith which is through him has made him well, before you all.

verses.en: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
verses.pt: E agora, irmãos, eu sei que vós fizestes isso por ignorância, assim como também vossos líderes.
verses.en_web: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
verses.en_bbe: And now, my brothers, I am conscious that you did this, as did your rulers, without knowledge.

verses.en: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
verses.pt: Mas Deus cumpriu assim o que já antes pela boca de todos os seus profetas ele tinha anunciado, que o Cristo tinha de sofrer.
verses.en_web: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
verses.en_bbe: But the things which God had made clear before, by the mouth of all the prophets, that the Christ would have to undergo, he has put into effect in this way.

verses.en: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
verses.pt: Arrependei-vos, pois, e convertei-vos, para que vosso pecados sejam apagados, quando vierem os tempos do refrigério da presença do Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,
verses.en_bbe: So then, let your hearts be changed and be turned to God, so that your sins may be completely taken away, and times of blessing may come from the Lord;

verses.en: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
verses.pt: E ele enviar a Jesus Cristo, que já vos foi pregado anteriormente.
verses.en_web: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,
verses.en_bbe: And that he may send the Christ who was marked out for you from the first, even Jesus:

verses.en: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
verses.pt: Ao qual convém que o céu receba até os tempos da restauração de todas as coisas, que Deus falou pela boca de todos os seus santos profetas, desde o princípio.
verses.en_web: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
verses.en_bbe: Who is to be kept in heaven till the time when all things are put right, of which God has given word by the mouth of his holy prophets, who have been from the earliest times.

verses.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
verses.pt: Porque Moisés disse aos nossos pais: O Senhor, vosso Deus, levantará dentre vossos irmãos um profeta como eu; a ele ouvireis em tudo o que ele vos falar.
verses.en_web: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
verses.en_bbe: For Moses said, The Lord will give you a prophet from among your people, like me; you will give ear to everything which he will say to you.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
verses.pt: E será que toda pessoa que não ouvir este profeta será exterminada do povo.
verses.en_web: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
verses.en_bbe: And every soul who does not give attention to that prophet, will be cut off from among the people.

verses.en: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
verses.pt: E também todos os profetas, desde Samuel e os posteriores, todos os que falaram, também anunciaram com antecedência destes dias.
verses.en_web: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.
verses.en_bbe: And all the prophets from Samuel and those who came after, every one of them, gave word of these days.

verses.en: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
verses.pt: Vós sois os filhos dos profetas e do pacto que Deus estabeleceu com nossos pais, dizendo a Abraão: E em tua semente serão abençoadas todas as famílias da terra.
verses.en_web: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘In your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed.’
verses.en_bbe: You are the sons of the prophets, and of the agreement which God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, Through your seed a blessing will come on all the families of the earth.

verses.en: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
verses.pt: Deus, ao ressuscitar seu filho Jesus, primeiro o enviou a vós, para que nisto vos abençoasse: afastando cada um de vós de vossas maldades”.
verses.en_web: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”
verses.en_bbe: To you, first, God sent his servant, blessing you by turning every one of you from his sins.
